messages:
Dana (Product): Quick sync 1: Finance pilot asked for SOC2/ISO-ready exports + per-tenant retention lanes. They want "full for control plane, sampled for inference" but also a forensic-tier for litigation. Need to align scope.
Marco (Security): Controls: full retention for auth, keystore ops, policy changes. For inference traces, allow deterministic sampling but provide an opt-in "forensic-tier" (paid) that keeps full traces for selected customers or sessions. Also require tamper-evidence (manifest + signature).
Lin (Eng-Infra): We can add a forensic-tier flag on tenant profile to route all traces into cold storage (cheap but retrievable). Sampling approach: hash(request_id || seed) mod 100 < pct -> deterministic. For forensic-tier, set pct=100.
Priya (Legal): SOC2 accepts sampling if reproducible and disclosed. ISO likes stronger integrity proofs; we should offer optional Merkle-chain inclusion in manifest for high-security customers. Need contract language for forensic-tier and key-rotation responsibilities.
Sohail (Solutions): Sales asks: 1) BYOK binding for export bundles, 2) signed manifests auditors can verify offline, 3) replay test for sampled vs full traces, 4) cost estimator per retention lane.
ExportBot: Created TASK-55577: "export-manifest-spec + forensic-tier-runbook" assigned to @Lin (Eng-Infra).
Marco (Security): Suggest manifest fields: manifest_version, time_window, sampling_seed, sampling_policy, wrapped_export_key, file_checksums, platform_signature, merkle_root (optional). Use ED25519 for platform signature and AES-256-GCM for payloads.
Lin (Eng-Infra): Implementation note: we must persist sampling_seed per time_window and log seed issuance event so auditors can reproduce selection. Indexing on tenant+request_id+time_window required for sub-4h exports. Estimate: 2 sprints for index + export worker.
Priya (Legal): I'll draft pilot addendum: default 90d retention, optional forensic-tier (paid) with 1yr/7yr archive options, deterministic sampling disclosure, export SLA, key-rotation notification (7d), and escrow-only-on-subpoena clause.
Sohail (Solutions): I'll create onboarding demo: provision BYOK, enable forensic-tier for a tenant, run export, verify manifest (including merkle_root if present), simulate key rotation and show previous bundles still verify.
Dana (Product): Proposed pilot acceptance criteria: 1) tenant policy API + Console toggle for retention lanes + forensic-tier, 2) signed export bundle with verifier guide (include merkle option), 3) BYOK export flow + rotation handling doc, 4) Console cost estimator, 5) pilot with 2 regulated customers + auditor walkthrough.
Lin (Eng-Infra): Draft manifest example (WIP):
```
{
  "manifest_version": "1",
  "tenant": "alpha-bank",
  "time_window": "2026-09-01T00:00:00Z/2026-09-02T00:00:00Z",
  "sampling_policy": "auth:full,trace:10%,forensic:true",
  "sampling_seed": "seed-20260901",
  "wrapped_export_key": "base64(...)",
  "files": ["trace-20260901-0001.ndjson.gz"],
  "checksums": ["sha256:..."],
  "merkle_root": "hex(...)",
  "platform_signature": "ed25519:..."
}
```
Marco (Security): Add `platform_signature_key_id` and `hash_algo` so external verifiers know how to validate merkle_root and files.
Dana (Product): Action items: Lin -> TASK-55577 prototype + infra estimate; Marco -> security spec for manifest + merkle guidance; Priya -> draft contract addendum; Sohail -> demo + cost slide. Reconvene Thu EOD. Drop blockers here and tag me.
